Q: How to estimate sub‑sample peak positions for very sharp periodic peaks with few cycles? A:

There are non-linear methods that will let you trade high signal to noise for additional frequency resolution, but you have to be very careful how you use it. Maximum entropy is probably one of the best known of these. A short introduction from Numerical Recipes is online entitled "13.7 Power Spectrum Estimation by the Maximum Entropy (All Poles) Method" to allow Google search if this link ever vanishes. If you propose to use it in anger for real data then I suggest reading a few of the papers and textbooks on the topic.

It works very well if you do have a very precise strong fixed frequency signals sampled at an arbitrary rate. But if the frequencies are varying even slightly then the peak tops will not be sharp. Common mistake is to overfit data by pretending that the noise is less than it really is (and that often leads to misleading peak splitting).

Q: SVG circle appears briefly at (0,0) before animating to correct position — how to fix? A:

To prevent an initial flash of unstyled/unpositioned content, use:

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/visibility
  • Hide the circle with visibility="hidden"
  • Show circle with <set attributeName="visibility" from="hidden" to="visible" begin="1s" />
  • if you want timing to match the animation, add a begin attribute on animate
  • change begin values
  • for a smoother animation animate (start) opacity also

<svg viewBox="0 0 30 30" style="background:pink;width:160px">
  <circle cx="15" cy="15" r="7" fill="green" visibility="hidden">
    <set attributeName="visibility" from="hidden" to="visible" begin="1s" />
    <animate attributeName="r" dur="1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" 
             begin="1s"
             values="7;11;7" keyTimes="0;0.5;1"
             calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.4 0 0.6 1; 0.4 0 0.6 1" />
    <animate attributeName="opacity" from="0" to="1" fill="freeze" 
             begin="1s" dur="1.5s"/>             
  </circle>
</svg>

Important to know, prevent yourself from pulling your hair out later:

  • Unlike HTML, SVG will allow a child to still be visible even if its parent is set to hidden;
    set visiblity="inherit" on the child element(s)
    (not documented on MDN)
<g visibility="hidden">
  <circle visibility="inherit" ... />
</g>

Q: Wrong language shown in AppStore A:

For me what worked is :

  1. Right Click on *.xcodeproj

  2. Show package contents

  3. Open project.pbxproj

  4. Find :

developmentRegion = en;

  1. Replace with :

developmentRegion = fr; (or whatever your target language is)

  1. Save

But that did not work until I also changed in : TARGET/Build Settings

Base SDK -> iOS

Before it was Automatic and consequently the title of the Info properties list was Custom MacOS Target Properties. After that it became Custom iOS Target Properties and the correct language was displayed in the AppStore.

The pity is how many revisions I had to publish on the store to find that out !
